# VP Eng - Leaning Grace

Saturday morning, not deciding yet. Decision is due 2026-10-20. Writing down where I am so I can see if it moves.

Leaning Grace Liu. Maybe 65/35.

## Why Grace
- Read Grace Liu - Reference Check Summary this morning. Priya N. got through more of them than I expected this early. Consistent theme: takes ops load off people without being asked, protects senior ICs from burnout, calm in incidents. That is literally the Marcus problem.
- In the final round (10/6) she asked more questions about our on-call and Pillar relationship than about her title. Good sign.
- She'd let me stop being the router. I believe that about her more than about Tomas.

## The concern, still real
- Never ran an org with regulated money movement. References don't fully answer that. Chime-adjacent isn't the same as owning the bank relationship.
- Mitigation idea: she shadows me with Pillar (Karim Haddad MBR, Theresa's ops sync) for her first 60 days, then owns the ops side. I keep the exec relationship until close + 1 quarter.

## Why not Tomas (yet)
- Final round 10/8 was strong. Best operator answer on the planning question.
- But: process-heavy. Three different people on the panel independently used the word "heavy". Our team is 31 people who chose a startup.
- His references haven't started. Not fair to compare a full picture to half of one. Keep him warm.

## What would change my mind
- A Grace reference that says she avoided incident ownership
- Tomas references showing he's lighter in practice than in interview
- Aleks strongly preferring Tomas

## Next
- [ ] Priya N.: finish remaining Grace references by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Priya N.: start Tomas references by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Hana: 1h with Grace on BSA/AML, schedule by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Talk to Aleks about where I'm leaning by 2026-10-14 (after Elena call, not before)
- [ ] Update VP Eng Decision Matrix with reference data by 2026-10-15
- [ ] VP Eng decision by 2026-10-20

Open question: does the regulated-money gap matter more or less once Marcus has a real payments team under him? Probably less.
Risk: I'm leaning Grace partly because she reminds me of the manager I wish I'd had. Check that against the matrix, not my gut.
